   640	    maxLevel: sp.tubeMaxLevel ?? 1,
   641	    stride: sp.tubeStride ?? 1,
   642	  });
   643	  bark.crownAO(skel.crownCenter, skel.crownRadius * 1.15, 0.28);
   644	  const cards = new MeshGrower();
   645	  if (sp.foliage) {
   646	    buildFoliageCards(cards, skel.anchors, sp.foliage.card, rng);
   647	    cards.bendNormals(skel.crownCenter, skel.crownRadius, sp.foliage.normalBend);

   653	export function buildFern(seed) {
   654	  const rng = makeRng(seed);
   655	  const g = new MeshGrower();
   656	  const fronds = 6 + rng.int(5);
   657	  const anchors = [];
   658	  const q = new THREE.Quaternion(), qt = new THREE.Quaternion();
   659	  const Y = new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0);
   660	  for (let i = 0; i < fronds; i++) {
   661	    const az = (i / fronds) * Math.PI * 2 + rng.float() * 0.6;
   662	    const pitch = 0.75 + rng.float() * 0.4;
   663	    q.setFromAxisAngle(Y, az);
   664	    qt.setFromAxisAngle(X, -(Math.PI / 2 - pitch));
   665	    q.multiply(qt);
   666	    anchors.push({
   667	      pos: new THREE.Vector3(Math.cos(az) * 0.03, 0.02, Math.sin(az) * 0.03),
   668	      quat: q.clone(), scale: 0.2 + rng.float() * 0.14,
   669	      hue: rng.float() * 2 - 1, age: rng.float() * 0.4,
   670	    });
   671	  }
   672	  // cross mode: single-plane fronds vanish edge-on and read as 2D cutouts
   673	  buildFoliageCards(g, anchors, { mode: 'cross', sizeK: 2.4, bend: 1.0 }, rng);
   674	  return g.build();
   675	}

   677	export function buildLog(seed, decay) {
   678	  const rng = makeRng(seed);
   679	  const g = new MeshGrower();
   680	  const len = 2.6 + rng.float() * 2.6;
   681	  const r0 = 0.16 + rng.float() * 0.16;
   682	  const segs = 9;
   683	  const pts = [], radii = [], dirs = [];
   684	  const wob = rng.float() * Math.PI * 2;
   685	  const squish = decay === 'rotten' ? 0.72 : 1;
   686	  for (let i = 0; i <= segs; i++) {
   687	    const t = i / segs;
   688	    pts.push(new THREE.Vector3(
   689	      (t - 0.5) * len,
   690	      (r0 * 0.82 - Math.sin(t * Math.PI) * 0.03 + Math.sin(t * 7 + wob) * 0.015) * squish,
   691	      Math.sin(t * 2.2 + wob) * len * 0.035));
   692	    const taper = decay === 'rotten' ? 0.88 : 0.94;
   693	    radii.push(r0 * (1 - t * (1 - taper)) * (1 + Math.sin(t * 13 + wob) * 0.05));
   694	    dirs.push(new THREE.Vector3(1, 0, Math.cos(t * 2.2 + wob) * 0.08).normalize());
   695	  }
   696	  const mossK = decay === 'fresh' ? 0.15 : decay === 'mossy' ? 0.8 : 1.0;
   697	  // moss tint folded into vertex color: green shift on the upper hemisphere
   698	  tubeForBranch(g, { level: 0, pts, radii, dirs, len, broken: true }, {
   699	    ringSegs: 10, uRepeats: 3, vScale: 1, capBase: true,
   700	    swayPhase: 0, swayFlexBase: 0, swayFlexTip: 0, tint: [1, 1, 1],
   701	  }, rng);
   702	  const col = g.col, nrm = g.nrm;
   703	  for (let i = 0; i < g.vertCount; i++) {
   704	    const up = Math.max(0, nrm[i * 3 + 1]);
   705	    const moss = mossK * up * up;
   706	    col[i * 3] *= 1 - moss * 0.55;
   707	    col[i * 3 + 1] *= 1 - moss * 0.1;
   708	    col[i * 3 + 2] *= 1 - moss * 0.62;
   709	  }
   710	  return { geometry: g.build(), length: len };
   711	}
   712	
   713	export function buildStump(seed) {
   714	  const rng = makeRng(seed);
   715	  const g = new MeshGrower();
   716	  const h = 0.5 + rng.float() * 0.6;
   717	  const r0 = 0.22 + rng.float() * 0.14;
   718	  const segs = 5;
   719	  const pts = [], radii = [], dirs = [];
   720	  for (let i = 0; i <= segs; i++) {
   721	    const t = i / segs;
   722	    pts.push(new THREE.Vector3((rng.float() - 0.5) * 0.02, t * h, (rng.float() - 0.5) * 0.02));
   723	    radii.push(r0 * (1 - t * 0.18));
   724	    dirs.push(new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0));
   725	  }
   726	  tubeForBranch(g, { level: 0, pts, radii, dirs, len: h, broken: true }, {
   727	    ringSegs: 10, uRepeats: 3, vScale: 1,
   728	    flare: { amp: 0.85, height: h * 0.55, lobes: 5, phase: rng.float() * 6.28 },
   729	    swayPhase: 0, swayFlexBase: 0, swayFlexTip: 0, tint: [1, 1, 1],
   730	  }, rng);
   731	  return { geometry: g.build(), length: h };
   732	}

   734	// glacial-erratic boulder: deformed icosphere, grey granite w/ moss cap
   735	export function buildBoulder(seed) {
   736	  const rng = makeRng(seed);
   737	  const geo = new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(1, 1);
   738	  const pos = geo.attributes.position;
   739	  const f1 = 1 + rng.float() * 0.6, f2 = 1 + rng.float() * 0.9;
   740	  for (let i = 0; i < pos.count; i++) {
   741	    const x = pos.getX(i), y = pos.getY(i), z = pos.getZ(i);
   742	    const d = 1 + 0.24 * Math.sin(x * 2.1 * f1 + 5 * rng.float() * 0) * Math.sin(z * 1.7 * f2 + y)
   743	      + 0.13 * Math.sin(y * 4.2 + x * 2.7) + 0.07 * Math.sin(z * 6.1 - y * 3.3);
   744	    pos.setXYZ(i, x * d, y * d * (0.62 + 0.2 * Math.abs(Math.sin(f1 * 3))), z * d);
   745	  }
   746	  geo.computeVertexNormals();
   747	  const col = new Float32Array(pos.count * 3);
   748	  for (let i = 0; i < pos.count; i++) {
   749	    const ny = geo.attributes.normal.getY(i);
   750	    const g0 = 0.52 + 0.14 * Math.sin(pos.getX(i) * 7.7 + pos.getZ(i) * 5.1);
   751	    const moss = Math.max(0, ny) * Math.max(0, ny) * 0.7;
   752	    col[i * 3] = g0 * (1 - moss * 0.5);
   753	    col[i * 3 + 1] = g0 * (1 - moss * 0.12);
   754	    col[i * 3 + 2] = g0 * (1 - moss * 0.55) * 0.98;
   755	  }
   756	  geo.setAttribute('color', new THREE.BufferAttribute(col, 3));
   757	  const wnd = new Float32Array(pos.count * 2);
   758	  geo.setAttribute('aWind', new THREE.BufferAttribute(wnd, 2));
   759	  return geo;
   760	}

     1	// Water bodies, all from real geometry: the Gauja ribbon (OSM course),

    10	function waterNormalTex() {
    11	  const n = makeNoise(777);
    12	  const tex = canvasTexture(256, 256, (ctx, w, h) => {
    13	    const img = ctx.createImageData(w, h);
    14	    // proper tangent-space normals derived from a ripple height field
    15	    const hgt = (x, y) =>
    16	      n.fbm((x / w) * 6, (y / h) * 6, 4) * 0.75 + n.noise2((x / w) * 22, (y / h) * 22) * 0.25;
    17	    for (let y = 0; y < h; y++) for (let x = 0; x < w; x++) {
    18	      const dx = (hgt(x + 1, y) - hgt(x - 1, y)) * 3.2;
    19	      const dy = (hgt(x, y + 1) - hgt(x, y - 1)) * 3.2;
    20	      const inv = 1 / Math.hypot(dx, dy, 1);
    21	      const i = (y * w + x) * 4;
    22	      img.data[i] = (-dx * inv * 0.5 + 0.5) * 255;
    23	      img.data[i + 1] = (-dy * inv * 0.5 + 0.5) * 255;
    24	      img.data[i + 2] = (inv * 0.5 + 0.5) * 255;
    25	      img.data[i + 3] = 255;
    26	    }
    27	    ctx.putImageData(img, 0, 0);
    28	  });
    29	  tex.colorSpace = THREE.NoColorSpace;
    30	  return tex;
    31	}

    33	function makeWaterMaterial(color, opacity) {
    34	  const m = new THREE.MeshPhongMaterial({
    35	    color,
    36	    shininess: 190,
    37	    specular: 0xb9c6d0,
    38	    transparent: true,
    39	    opacity,
    40	    normalMap: waterNormalTex(),
    41	    normalScale: new THREE.Vector2(0.26, 0.26),
    42	    side: THREE.DoubleSide, // river ribbons follow flow direction; don't let winding cull them
    43	  });
    44	  // second ripple octave scrolling against the first — interference, not slide
    45	  m.userData.off2 = new THREE.Vector2();
    46	  m.onBeforeCompile = (sh) => {
    47	    sh.uniforms.uOff2 = { value: m.userData.off2 };
    48	    sh.fragmentShader = 'uniform vec2 uOff2;\n' + sh.fragmentShader.replace(
    49	      'vec3 mapN = texture2D( normalMap, vNormalMapUv ).xyz * 2.0 - 1.0;',
    50	      `vec3 mapN1 = texture2D( normalMap, vNormalMapUv ).xyz * 2.0 - 1.0;
    51	       vec3 mapN2 = texture2D( normalMap, vNormalMapUv * 3.7 + uOff2 ).xyz * 2.0 - 1.0;
    52	       vec3 mapN = normalize(vec3(mapN1.xy + mapN2.xy * 0.45, mapN1.z));`
    53	    );
    54	  };
    55	  return m;
    56	}

    58	// Water ribbon, LAAS-shore rules: high tessellation so bends are CURVES
    59	// (the old 63m segments read as rectangles), and a FLAT surface — the
    60	// shoreline comes from the carved bank rising through the plane.
    61	function ribbon(pts, widthFn, mat, uvScale = 60, edgeDrop = 0.85) {
    62	  // SEG and the tangent window MUST match the bank skirt exactly — the
    63	  // skirt's inner verts are meant to be vertex-for-vertex identical with
    64	  // these edges; any tessellation drift opens black slivers into the trench
    65	  const SEG = Math.min(2000, pts.length * 6);
    66	  // LAAS shore rule: the water surface is FLAT (a sloped surface reads as a
    67	  // convex hump from the bank) — only a slight edge tuck hides the seam.
    68	  // The shoreline itself comes from the bank rising THROUGH the plane, so
    69	  // the spline-following channel carve must clear the full ribbon width.
    70	  const EDGE_DROP = edgeDrop;
    71	  // 5 verts per row: the surface stays DEAD FLAT out to ~96% width, then a
    72	  // short near-vertical rim drops under the bank collar. A gradual slope
    73	  // read as a dark tilted band along every shore at grazing angles.
    74	  const positions = [], uvs = [], indices = [];
    75	  for (let i = 0; i <= SEG; i++) {
    76	    const t = i / SEG;
    77	    const [x, z, y] = sampleSpline(pts, t);
    78	    const [xa, za] = sampleSpline(pts, Math.max(0, t - 0.004));
    79	    const [x2, z2] = sampleSpline(pts, Math.min(1, t + 0.004));
    80	    let dx = x2 - xa, dz = z2 - za;
    81	    const len = Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 1;
    82	    dx /= len; dz /= len;
    83	    const w = widthFn(t) + 1.6; // overshoot into the banks
    84	    const wf = w - 0.5;         // flat out to here
    85	    positions.push(
    86	      x - dz * w, y - EDGE_DROP, z + dx * w,
    87	      x - dz * wf, y, z + dx * wf,
    88	      x, y, z,
    89	      x + dz * wf, y, z - dx * wf,
    90	      x + dz * w, y - EDGE_DROP, z - dx * w);
    91	    uvs.push(0, t * uvScale, 0.04, t * uvScale, 0.5, t * uvScale, 0.96, t * uvScale, 1, t * uvScale);
    92	    if (i < SEG) {
    93	      const a = i * 5;
    94	      for (let k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
    95	        indices.push(a + k, a + k + 1, a + k + 6, a + k, a + k + 6, a + k + 5);
    96	      }
    97	    }
    98	  }
    99	  const geo = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
   100	  geo.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(positions, 3));
   101	  geo.setAttribute('uv', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(uvs, 2));
   102	  geo.setIndex(indices);
   103	  geo.computeVertexNormals();
   104	  return new THREE.Mesh(geo, mat);
   105	}

   107	export function buildWater() {
   108	  const group = new THREE.Group();

   123	        q.push([a2[0] * 0.75 + b2[0] * 0.25, a2[1] * 0.75 + b2[1] * 0.25]);
   124	        q.push([a2[0] * 0.25 + b2[0] * 0.75, a2[1] * 0.25 + b2[1] * 0.75]);

   307	  function tick(t) {
   308	    for (const m of mats) {

   310	      m.userData.off2.set(-t * 0.019, t * 0.011);
   311	    }

   313	  // glacial-era meltwater is milky with rock flour
   314	  const original = mats.map((m) => m.color.clone());
   315	  function setEra(era) {

    50	    // between samples and the channel bed rose in ridges (the river read as

    73	    const RX = 56, RZ = 38;
    74	    for (let gy = 0; gy < G; gy++) for (let gx = 0; gx < G; gx++) {
    75	      const [x, z] = cellToWorld(gx, gy);
    76	      const nx = (x - (P.x + 4)) / RX, nz = (z - P.z) / RZ;
    77	      const rr = Math.hypot(nx, nz);

    89	    const cgy = Math.round((((p.z - OZ) / SPAN) + 0.5) * (G - 1));
    90	    if (p.y === undefined) p.y = field[cgy * G + cgx];
    91	    const cr = Math.ceil((p.r + 24) / CELL) + 1;
    92	    for (let dy = -cr; dy <= cr; dy++) for (let dx = -cr; dx <= cr; dx++) {
    93	      const gx = cgx + dx, gy = cgy + dy;
    94	      if (gx < 0 || gy < 0 || gx >= G || gy >= G) continue;
    95	      const [x, z] = cellToWorld(gx, gy);
    96	      const d = Math.hypot(p.x - x, p.z - z);
    97	      if (d < p.r + 24) {
    98	        const i = gy * G + gx;
    99	        field[i] = lerp(field[i], p.y, smoothstep(p.r + 24, p.r * 0.55, d));
   100	      }

    48	  // blend normals toward a sphere around center — the crown-cohesion trick

    48	        float swayB = sin(uWindT * f1 * 1.31 + phase * 1.7) * gust * uWindS;
    49	        vec2 disp = uWindD * (lean + 0.32 * swayA) + vec2(-uWindD.y, uWindD.x) * 0.16 * swayB;

    51	        transformed += normal * (sin(uWindT * 4.7 + phase + transformed.x * 3.1)
    52	          * 0.02 * aWind.x * uWindS);

    54	      `);

    56	  return material;
    57	}

    59	// legacy vertex-colour wind (still used by the reeds and small props)
    60	export function windify(material) {
    61	  material.onBeforeCompile = (sh) => {
    62	    sh.uniforms.uWindT = WIND.time;
    63	    sh.uniforms.uWindD = WIND.dir;
    64	    sh.uniforms.uWindS = WIND.strength;
    65	    sh.vertexShader = 'uniform float uWindT; uniform vec2 uWindD; uniform float uWindS;\n' +
    66	      sh.vertexShader.replace('#include <begin_vertex>', `
    67	      #include <begin_vertex>
    68	      #ifdef USE_INSTANCING
    69	      {
    70	        vec3 iPos = vec3(instanceMatrix[3][0], instanceMatrix[3][1], instanceMatrix[3][2]);
    71	        float phase = fract(sin(dot(iPos.xz, vec2(12.9898, 78.233))) * 43758.5453) * 6.2831;
    72	        float flex = clamp((vColor.g - vColor.r) * 2.2, 0.0, 1.0) * transformed.y * transformed.y;
    73	        float gust = 0.55 + 0.45 * sin(dot(iPos.xz, uWindD) * 0.018 - uWindT * 1.25 + phase * 0.31);
    74	        float f = 1.0 + fract(phase * 2.7) * 1.6;
    75	        float lean = uWindS * uWindS * 0.5;
    76	        float swayA = sin(uWindT * f + phase) * gust * uWindS;
    77	        float swayB = sin(uWindT * f * 1.31 + phase * 1.7) * gust * uWindS;
    78	        vec2 disp = uWindD * (lean + 0.24 * swayA) + vec2(-uWindD.y, uWindD.x) * 0.12 * swayB;
    79	        transformed.xz += disp * flex;
    80	      }
    81	      #endif
    82	      `);
    83	  };
    84	  return material;
    85	}

   177	  // alpha-to-coverage rides the composer's 4x MSAA: soft dithered leaf edges
   178	  // instead of the hard alpha-test fizz that reads as grit in the mips
   179	  // alphaTest 0.24 trims the mushy dither zone that read as half-rendered
   180	  // leaves up close while A2C still softens the silhouettes
   181	  const m = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({
   182	    map: atlas, vertexColors: true, alphaTest: 0.24, alphaToCoverage: true,
   183	    side: THREE.DoubleSide,
   184	  });

   186	  const prev = m.onBeforeCompile;
   187	  m.onBeforeCompile = (sh) => {
   188	    prev(sh);

   190	    sh.fragmentShader = sh.fragmentShader.replace(
   191	      '#include <map_fragment>',
   192	      `#ifdef USE_MAP

   194	       sampledDiffuseColor.rgb *= sampledDiffuseColor.rgb;
   195	       diffuseColor *= sampledDiffuseColor;
   196	       #endif`);
   197	  };
   198	  m.customDepthMaterial = null; // set on the mesh, not the material
   199	  return m;
   200	}
   201	function cardDepthMaterial(atlas) {
   202	  return new THREE.MeshDepthMaterial({
   203	    depthPacking: THREE.RGBADepthPacking, map: atlas, alphaTest: 0.38,
   204	  });

import { LOC, distToRoad, roadsForEra } from './src/landuse.js';
import { heightAt } from './src/terrain.js';
import { RIVER_PTS } from './src/geodata.js';
import { sampleSpline } from './src/util.js';
const S=LOC.STEAD, M=LOC.MANOR;
function distToSpline(x,z){let bd=Infinity,bt=0,bp=null; const N=Math.min(3000,RIVER_PTS.length*8); for(let i=0;i<=N;i++){const p=sampleSpline(RIVER_PTS,i/N); const d=Math.hypot(p[0]-x,p[1]-z); if(d<bd){bd=d;bt=i/N;bp=p;}} return {d:bd,t:bt,p:bp};}
const poles=[];
for(let zz=-700,i=0; zz<=900 && i<60; zz+=46,i++){
  const x=S.x+46+Math.sin(zz*0.004)*4;
  const r=distToSpline(x,zz);
  const dr=distToRoad(4,x,zz);
  const oldDist=Math.hypot(x-(M.x-105),zz-(M.z-15));
  poles.push({i, x:+x.toFixed(2), z:zz, river:+r.d.toFixed(2), riverPt:r.p.map(v=>+v.toFixed(1)), road:+dr.toFixed(2), oldManor:+oldDist.toFixed(2), y:+heightAt(x,zz).toFixed(2)});
}
console.log('S',S,'M',M,'oldManor',{x:M.x-105,z:M.z-15});
console.log('near river', poles.filter(p=>p.river<12).map(p=>({i:p.i,x:p.x,z:p.z,river:p.river,riverPt:p.riverPt,road:p.road,oldManor:p.oldManor})));
